pr_body:
Add comparisons of `float[]` queries with `byte[]` vectors

This fixes #117274
pr_title: Add basic implementations of float-byte script comparisons
pr_comment: We could do this the other way too - add implementations of `BinaryDenseVector.dotProduct(byte[])` and friends
Hi @thecoop, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

I think this looks good as a first step. 

Could you add some tests here: modules/lang-painless/src/yamlRestTest/resources/rest-api-spec/test/painless/145_dense_vector_byte_basic.yml

Obviously, a component will need to be added. But it will help increase our coverage for free.
More heterogenous methods can be introduced in later PRs using this infrastructure

review_comment:
We should optionally normalize the floating point value. For cosine, we don't want to calculate the magnitude at EVERY comparison. Instead, we should normalize, and then use the `cosineSimilarity(floatValues, false)`

So, the Cosine impl will pass a boolean `true` called `boolean normalizeFloatQuery`, and  all other impls will pass a false.
Panama implementation can be added as a separate PR
I think this is fine, we should keep this value so it can be used later.
